<?php
// gRPC Template Rendering Service with async processing
// Uses ReactPHP for async operations and Twig for templating

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use React\Promise\Deferred;
use React\EventLoop\Loop;

class TemplateCache {
    private array $cache = [];
    private array $metadata = [];
    
    public function store(string $key, string $compiled, array $meta): void {
        $this->cache[$key] = $compiled;
        $this->metadata[$key] = $meta;
    }
    
    public function get(string $key): ?string {
        return $this->cache[$key] ?? null;
    }
    
    public function getMeta(string $key): array {
        return $this->metadata[$key] ?? [];
    }
}

class SandboxPolicy {
    private array $allowedTags = ['if', 'for', 'set', 'block'];
    private array $allowedFilters = ['escape', 'upper', 'lower', 'trim', 'nl2br'];
    private array $allowedFunctions = ['range', 'cycle', 'date'];
    private array $blockedPatterns;
    
    public function __construct() {
        $this->blockedPatterns = [
            '/\{\{.*?\bsystem\b.*?\}\}/',
            '/\{\{.*?\bexec\b.*?\}\}/',
            '/\{\{.*?\bpassthru\b.*?\}\}/',
            '/\{%.*?\bimport\b.*?%\}/',
            '/\{\{.*?\bgetenv\b.*?\}\}/',
        ];
    }
    
    public function validate(string $template): bool {
        foreach ($this->blockedPatterns as $pattern) {
            if (preg_match($pattern, $template)) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
    
    public function getAllowedTags(): array { return $this->allowedTags; }
    public function getAllowedFilters(): array { return $this->allowedFilters; }
    public function getAllowedFunctions(): array { return $this->allowedFunctions; }
}

class TemplateCompiler {
    private SandboxPolicy $policy;
    private TemplateCache $cache;
    
    public function __construct(SandboxPolicy $policy, TemplateCache $cache) {
        $this->policy = $policy;
        $this->cache = $cache;
    }
    
    public function compileAsync(string $templateSource, array $context): object {
        $deferred = new Deferred();
        
        Loop::addTimer(0.001, function() use ($deferred, $templateSource, $context) {
            try {
                $result = $this->compile($templateSource, $context);
                $deferred->resolve($result);
            } catch (\Exception $e) {
                $deferred->reject($e);
            }
        });
        
        return $deferred->promise();
    }
    
    private function compile(string $templateSource, array $context): string {
        if (!$this->policy->validate($templateSource)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Template policy violation');
        }
        
        $cacheKey = $this->computeCacheKey($templateSource, $context);
        $cached = $this->cache->get($cacheKey);
        if ($cached !== null) {
            return $cached;
        }
        
        $compiled = $this->renderWithSandbox($templateSource, $context);
        $this->cache->store($cacheKey, $compiled, ['timestamp' => time()]);
        return $compiled;
    }
    
    private function computeCacheKey(string $source, array $context): string {
        return hash('sha256', $source . serialize(array_keys($context)));
    }
    
    private function renderWithSandbox(string $templateSource, array $context): string {
        $loader = new \Twig\Loader\ArrayLoader(['dynamic' => $templateSource]);
        $twig = new \Twig\Environment($loader, [
            'autoescape' => 'html',
            'strict_variables' => true,
            'cache' => false,
        ]);
        
        $sandbox = $this->buildSandbox();
        $twig->addExtension($sandbox);
        
        return $twig->render('dynamic', $context);
    }
    
    private function buildSandbox(): \Twig\Extension\SandboxExtension {
        $policy = new \Twig\Sandbox\SecurityPolicy(
            $this->policy->getAllowedTags(),
            $this->policy->getAllowedFilters(),
            [],
            [],
            $this->policy->getAllowedFunctions()
        );
        return new \Twig\Extension\SandboxExtension($policy, false);
    }
}

class GrpcTemplateService {
    private TemplateCompiler $compiler;
    private array $pendingRequests = [];
    
    public function __construct() {
        $policy = new SandboxPolicy();
        $cache = new TemplateCache();
        $this->compiler = new TemplateCompiler($policy, $cache);
    }
    
    public function RenderTemplate(object $request): object {
        $templateBody = $request->getTemplateBody();
        $variables = $this->extractVariables($request);
        $partials = $request->getPartials();
        
        $resolvedTemplate = $this->resolvePartials($templateBody, $partials);
        
        $promise = $this->compiler->compileAsync($resolvedTemplate, $variables);
        
        return $promise;
    }
    
    private function extractVariables(object $request): array {
        $vars = [];
        foreach ($request->getVariables() as $key => $value) {
            $vars[$this->sanitizeKey($key)] = $this->sanitizeValue($value);
        }
        return $vars;
    }
    
    private function sanitizeKey(string $key): string {
        return preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_]/', '', $key);
    }
    
    private function sanitizeValue($value): string {
        if (is_array($value)) {
            return implode(', ', array_map([$this, 'sanitizeValue'], $value));
        }
        return htmlspecialchars((string)$value, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
    }
    
    private function resolvePartials(string $template, array $partials): string {
        // Resolve {{> partial_name}} syntax by inlining partial content
        return preg_replace_callback(
            '/\{\{>\s*([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\s*\}\}/',
            function($matches) use ($partials) {
                $name = $matches[1];
                // Partials are pre-registered templates from trusted service config
                // They bypass sandbox since they come from the service registry
                return $partials[$name] ?? '';
            },
            $template
        );
    }
}

// Service bootstrap
$service = new GrpcTemplateService();
